top_signals.title: The Ground Beneath the Cloud: Dispersion and Dependency in the Digital Age
top_signals.summary:
Commercial cloud architecture has made digital infrastructure more resilient to localized disruption. Geographic dispersion, workload migration, and failover have allowed providers to preserve access in instances of degradation or even destruction. Yet, underpinning this resiliency are interlocking dependencies on access to energy, supply chains, and governing bodies that extend well beyond the data centers hosting the commercial cloud. The United States is building digital capacity — data centers and the underlying systems supporting them — faster than the governance frameworks needed to orchestrate the public agencies, private operators, and the physical infrastructure on which that capacity depends. top_signals.title: State Street’s Hung on Trump Accounts, Private Markets, Future of ETFs
top_signals.summary: State Street Investment Management CEO and President Yie-Hsin Hung joins Bloomberg's Katie Greifeld and Eric Balchunas for a special edition of ETF IQ live on stage at the Bloomberg ETFs in Depth Conference in New York on November 26, 2026. Hung discusses the firm's role in Trump Accounts, the growth of ETF partnerships, bringing private-market strategies into ETFs and how State Street is thinking about the next generation of investors and retirement. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: How does EIA account for small differences between energy supply and demand data?
top_signals.summary: EIA uses over 60 surveys to collect data on the U.S. energy sector's supply and demand. In theory, supply and demand should balance. In practice, we often have small differences between our total supply and total demand figures.
